line: Ten of Wands: Crowley's title, planetary attribution and place on the Tree, with his account of the card.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: Title and planet, as the chapter gives them (pdf 181, 195).

quotes.quote: The Ten of Wands is called Oppression.
The card also refers to the influence of Saturn in Sagittarius.

sections.title: Its place on the Tree
sections.line: The Tens belong to Malkuth (pdf 181), and this card's chapter gives the number Ten as Malkuth (pdf 195).

quotes.quote: These cards are attributed to Malkuth.
The number Ten refers to Malkuth, which depends from the other nine Sephiroth,

sections.title: What the card figures
sections.line: His description of the picture, not a divinatory reading.

quotes.quote: The whole picture suggests Oppression and repression.

sections.title: Conflicts and gaps
sections.line: The Tens group intro says there is now no planetary attribution to consider (pdf 181). This card's chapter names Saturn in Sagittarius, and the attribution table agrees with the chapter. The record keeps the chapter's planet; the group intro is the conflict.

quotes.quote: There is now no planetary attribution to consider.
